bio.text: Don Wagner, a Republican, is a candidate for California Secretary of State in 2026 and has served on the Orange County Board of Supervisors, representing District 3, since 2019.
He was Mayor of Irvine from 2016 to 2019 and a member of the California State Assembly from 2010 to 2016.
Wagner holds a B.A. in English from the University of California, Los Angeles, and a J.D. from the University of California, Hastings, and works as an attorney.
